amendment_note: Prospective unseen-corpus replication and out-of-corpus predictor selection. Frozen after v2.0 and after source-only byte materialization, but before any v2.1 Fourier profile or learning curve was computed.

intervention.transform: split each fixed byte stream into s equal contiguous lanes and emit the transpose round-robin
invariants: source corpus within each stride block
intervention.intended_variation: eight radii plus naturally varying W0/W1/W2 across six unseen corpora, allowing out-of-corpus comparison of radius-only, conditional, and total-Parseval scaling

spectrum.position_sampling: uniform corpus-wide time indices with every interleaved lane represented in both cross-fit folds

difficulty.primary: dataset-stride median final held-out CE divided by initial held-out CE; higher is harder
difficulty.secondary: dataset-stride median normalized held-out curve area over log1p token time

geometry_replication_test.statistic: mean of six within-dataset Spearman correlations between G_total and primary difficulty
geometry_replication_test.null: independently permute the eight difficulty ranks within every dataset
geometry_replication_test.p_value: two-sided exact probability computed by convolution of the six n=8 Spearman permutation distributions
geometry_replication_test.support_rule: geometry replicated if mean rho>=0.70, exact p<0.01, stride-16 difficulty exceeds stride-1 in at least 5 of 6 datasets, and seed-specific blocked mean rho is positive for all three seeds

predictor_selection_test.procedure: for each predictor and held-out corpus, subtract that corpus's stride-1 value, fit a zero-intercept slope on the other five corpora, and predict held-out stride deltas; aggregate squared error over the seven nonbaseline strides
predictor_selection_test.identifiability_gate: absolute Pearson correlation of flattened within-corpus-centered G_total with every competing predictor must be below 0.995
predictor_selection_test.selection_rule: G_TOTAL_SELECTED if geometry replicates, G_total has the lowest LOCO RMSE, its RMSE is at least 5% below the runner-up, it beats log2_radius RMSE in at least 5 of 6 held-out corpora, and the identifiability gate passes

scope: out-of-corpus validation of locality and comparison of scalar geometry summaries on six fixed real byte corpora for this learner; not a universal cross-domain law
